content.problemStatement:
Number of inversion

Write a program to count the number of inversion in a given array.

Two element a[i] and a[j] form an inversion ifa[i] > a[j] and i <j. For simplicity, we may assume that all elements are unique.

Expected Output :

The given array is : 1 9 6 4 5

The inversions are: (9, 6) (9, 4) (9, 5) (6, 4) (6, 5)

The number of inversion can be formed from the array is: 5
content.inputFormat: The input contains the number of elements and the values

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Print each inversion pair (arr[i], arr[j]) where i < j and arr[i] > arr[j], followed by total count.
solution.editorial: Iterate pairs i < j, output each inversion pair on a newline, then output total inversion count.
